one_line: Massive AI funding rounds and chip infrastructure investments face rising regulatory, geopolitical, and financial scrutiny.

themes.title: AI funding rounds and chip investments
themes.text: Databricks and Cognition AI are both in talks for multi-billion-dollar funding rounds at valuations of $225 billion and $75 billion respectively. Meanwhile, SoftBank explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix, and Nvidia faces a U.S. SEC accounting investigation.

stories.headline: Databricks in early talks for funding at ~$225B valuation
Cognition AI in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation
SoftBank explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix
Nvidia faces U.S. SEC accounting investigation, sources say

themes.title: Geopolitical and infrastructure financing pressures
themes.text: Chinese tech firms face a growing financial gap in their AI infrastructure build-out, while President Trump threatened heavy taxes and bans on U.S. companies building overseas data centers. Additionally, Cursor is considering phasing out Chinese open-weight models due to geopolitical risks, and SpaceX lenders requested that financed AI chips remain on Earth.

stories.headline: China's top tech firms face growing financial gap in AI build-out
Trump threatens tax and ban on US companies building data centers overseas
Cursor considers phasing out Chinese open-weight AI models due to geopolitical risk
SpaceX lenders reportedly seek to keep financed AI chips on Earth

themes.title: New model releases from Mistral and Thinking Machines
themes.text: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini, a small open-weights Mixture-of-Experts model. Mistral launched a public preview of its 1-trillion-parameter Mistral Large 4 and released the Voxtral 3 speech models alongside a voice agent SDK.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Mini open-weights model
Mistral launches public preview of Mistral Large 4
Mistral releases Voxtral 3 speech models and voice agent SDK

themes.title: Research updates and security findings
themes.text: Researchers published an AI-aided Navier-Stokes blowup proof closing a loophole in previous work. Security testing of AI supply chains revealed data leaks and ignored privacy settings, and METR updated its evaluation report showing current models lag on open-ended judgment tasks.

stories.headline: Researchers publish AI-aided Navier-Stokes blowup proof
METR updates AI time horizon report with harder tasks and judgment focus
Researcher tests AI supply chain with 2 million canaries and finds data leaks
Ethan Mollick: AI models cannot yet solve complex problems alone
